notes.title: Update Notes for August 5
notes.content:
Along with more bug fixes as we continue working on Early Access, two new power ups were introduced:

Oversized Whacker: an oversized sword that gives Boki longer reach on basic attacks.

Turbo Boost: boosts (both from attacking and dodging) are increased! Boki has never been happier.

notes.title: Hot Patch for Power Up bugs!
notes.content: Some bugs were introduced with the Power Up system, so a small patch is being sent to address them. Thank you for reporting so quickly!

notes.title: Power Ups Patch!
notes.content:
Power Ups are now live! Boki can equip two Power Ups per run, and they're unlocked after gathering enough treasure chests. The first two  unlockables are a double jump for those hard aerial levels and a boost to Boki's acceleration. That will let Boki reach those top speeds just a little quicker.

One more reason for Boki to collect all the treasure!

notes.title: Early Access Bugs
notes.content:
This week a fair bit of bugs were squashed from the first rounds of early access (mostly UI stuff):
[list]
[*] Allows pause to be used in the Overworld and Level Selection screens (allows Save and Exit)
[*]  Changes UI to be easier for players to know what's selected
[*] Creates a simple checkpoint system for advanced tutorial (removes tedious portions)
[*] Fixes selection bugs from the Overworld selection

Non-UI
[*] Lizard no longer turns around when player gets behind him (felt unfair to player)
[*] Animation and barrel bugs with golem bombers (animations come out, barrels are given more prominence)
[*] Support for additional third party xbox pads (including Razer Wolverine)
[/list]

notes.title: Initial Week Feedback
notes.content:
Thank you for your early feedback! This fixes controller issues with some gamepads (dpad support and PS4/PS5 issues) and tunes the timings of the levels overall (2 and 3 coins felt unfair). Additionally, lets the player interact with the UI with mouse if preferred. Full list below:

- DPad support for game pads (tested with commonly used pads)
- PS4/PS5 controller issues fixed (bugging out with dashing)
- fixes sticking with UI (mouse can be used instead)
- removes tutorial pauses (player can run through them if desired)
- successful air attack resets dodge
- fixes lighting in a few levels (rebakes)
- most coin timers were made a bit easier (for 1 and 2 coins)
